# RASID

> RASID builds GoPilot, an AI geospatial agent. Ask a geospatial question in
> plain language; GoPilot finds the right Earth-observation data, selects the
> right AI models, runs the analysis, and returns raster and vector answers.
> RASID is a B2B geospatial-AI company with offices in Paris, France and Beirut,
> Lebanon. Winner, AWS Generative AI Challenge 2026.

RASID turns satellite and Earth-observation imagery into decision-ready
intelligence through one natural-language interface over 10,000+ datasets and
hundreds of AI models. Everything GoPilot does is also exposed over the Model
Context Protocol (MCP) as GoServers, and inside QGIS and ArcGIS Pro via plugins.

## About
- [About RASID and GoPilot](https://rasid.ai/about): What RASID does, how GoPilot works step by step, the data and models it uses, and a FAQ covering pricing, MCP access, plugins and sectors. The most complete single page on the site.

## Products
- [GoPilot](https://rasid.ai/products#gopilot): AI geospatial agent for plain-language questions to raster/vector answers.
- [GoServers (MCP / API)](https://rasid.ai/products#mcps): Four MCP servers: GoServer-Fetch (data retrieval), GoServer-Geo (vector operations), GoServer-Analyze (raster and time-series analysis), GoServer-AI (model inference). Orchestrated by GoPilot on every plan; direct MCP / API access is available on the Enterprise plan.
- [Plugins](https://rasid.ai/products#plugins): GoPilot inside QGIS and ArcGIS Pro.

## Services
- [Urban](https://rasid.ai/services#urban): Building/road counting, settlement planning, solar-panel detection, land-use mapping.
- [Agriculture](https://rasid.ai/services#agriculture): National crop mapping, field delineation, phenology, tree/olive detection.
- [Defense](https://rasid.ai/services#defense): Q&A on tensions and strike sites with before/after change-detection verification.
- [Environmental](https://rasid.ai/services#environmental): Methane monitoring, deforestation, water/coastline change.
- [Transportation](https://rasid.ai/services#transportation): Vehicle-speed mapping from satellite video, iRAP road-safety automation, network extraction.
- [AI Consultancy](https://rasid.ai/services#ai-consultancy): Custom AI beyond geospatial, including OCR and document intelligence, computer vision, LLM and agent integration, and MLOps.

## Case studies
- [GoPilot: RASID's AI geospatial agent](https://rasid.ai/case-studies/gopilot-ai-geospatial-agent): The agent itself, built on AWS Bedrock with Claude and SAM3/DINOv3 vision pipelines, delivered through the web app, QGIS and ArcGIS Pro. Winner of the AWS GenAI for Geospatial Challenge (EMEA), 2026.
- [MethaneMapper: monitoring methane plumes from space](https://rasid.ai/case-studies/methanemapper-landfill-detection): Physics-informed methane detection from Sentinel-2 imagery, combining synthetic plume generation with deep learning to identify potential methane emission sources from space.
- [BananaSight: early warning for Fusarium wilt TR4](https://rasid.ai/case-studies/bananasight-tr4-lebanon): Sentinel-2 time-series monitoring across 713 annotated Lebanese banana fields, flagging crop stress before damage is irreversible. Funded by the EBRD Innovation Programme in Lebanon.
- [C-ARD: raw to corrected analysis-ready data](https://rasid.ai/case-studies/c-ard-analysis-ready-data): An AI pipeline correcting geometric and radiometric defects plus cloud, haze and shadow in high-resolution imagery, processing around 200 GB in about two hours.

## Publications
- [Quantum Meets SAR: A Novel Range-Doppler Algorithm for Next-Gen Earth Observation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.01832): Earth Observation and Geomatics Engineering 10(1), 83-92, 2026. Quantum Fourier Transform applied to SAR range-Doppler processing.
- [A Decade of Wheat Mapping for Lebanon](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.11366): IEEE EarthSense 2025. DOI 10.1109/EarthSense66084.2025.11297250. Transformer time-series model plus field delineation for national wheat mapping.
- [Efficient Adaptation for Remote Sensing Visual Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.23083): IEEE IGARSS 2025. DOI 10.1109/IGARSS55030.2025.11243354. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA, BitFit, adapters) for text-driven object location in satellite imagery.
- [All publications](https://rasid.ai/publications)

## Pricing
- [Pricing](https://rasid.ai/#pricing): Free (€0/mo, 500 tokens); Pro (€149/mo, 5,000 tokens); Business (€499/mo, 25,000 tokens); Enterprise (custom, on-prem/cloud + MCP connector). Tokens are shared across GoPilot, GoBox, and MCP/API services.
